== History ==
Former DM-clan [[The Outcasts Clan]] switched to [[Capture the Flag]] and became [[The Millenium Outcasts]] a Swedish HPW-CTF clan.

2000 is to be considered among the very best HPW-CTF clans at this time in Scandinavia.

== Information ==

* Founded: [[1997]] by [[Lethalwiz]] and [[Lob0]]
* Nationality: [[Image:flag_se.gif]] Swedish 
* Clan prefix: [2000]
* IRC channel: [irc://port80.se.quakenet.org/2000 #2000] ([[QuakeNet]])
* Website: http://web.telia.com/~u24007726/
